say:1:1623335001:1.text: We have a real problem. Alchemy accidents have been happening a bit too often lately.
say:1:1623335001:1.source_cn: 近期的炼金事故频率超出了正常阈值。
say:1:1623335001:1.male: We have a real problem. Alchemy accidents have been happening a bit too often lately.
say:1:1623335001:1.female: We have a real problem. Alchemy accidents have been happening a bit too often lately.

say:2:1623335002:1.text: Someone dumped leftover potions, and it set off a chain reaction. Enchanted things went haywire. Magic books are charging down the hallways, and a bunch of students have been hurt.
say:2:1623335002:1.source_cn: 废弃魔法药水导致了魔法造物的异常活化，大量魔法书在教学...

say:3:1623335003:1.text: I need you to take care of it.

say:3:1623335003:1.female: I need you to take care of it.

say:4:1623335004:1.text: First priority is getting the school back under control. Our students shouldn't end up flinching at the sight of a book, right?
say:4:1623335004:1.source_cn: 首要目标是恢复校园秩序，莱希拉姆的学生不该对魔法书产生...

say:0:1623336001:0.text: Easy... settle down, you little terrors.

say:0:1623336001:0.female: Easy... settle down, you little terrors.

say:0:1623337001:0.text: Alright, that lot's handled. Time to find the next batch.
say:0:1623337001:0.source_cn: 应该没问题了，去找下一批。
say:0:1623337001:0.male: Alright, that lot's handled. Time to find the next batch.
say:0:1623337001:0.female: Alright, that lot's handled. Time to find the next batch.

say:0:1623338001:0.text: Last warning. Calm down, or you're getting tossed in the bin.

say:0:1623339001:0.text: Whew... Done. Better go report back to Professor Zorya.

say:0:1623339001:0.male: Whew... Done. Better go report back to Professor Zorya.
say:0:1623339001:0.female: Whew... Done. Better go report back to Professor Zorya.
